=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:941-959 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: list_violated_files() hardcodes pr_num="?" when calling _evaluate_fp_state(), while verify() correctly extracts the real pr_num from the fingerprint entry.
  WHY: With pr_num="?", the partial-removal false-positive defense never fires in list mode, so --list-violated-files reports files as violated that verify() would skip as false positives.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3073-3074 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The capture-side git fetch wraps the command with env GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 timeout "${integration_fetch_timeout_secs}s" but does not check whether the timeout binary exists before using it.
  WHY: On runners lacking timeout, the post-merge presence filter is skipped entirely; correctness is preserved by verifier-side defense, but the capture-side filter becomes a no-op.
